title: MySQL professional readiness assessment

questions.prompt: In a normalized e-commerce database, where should a customer email uniqueness rule be enforced?
options: Only in frontend form validation
With a database UNIQUE constraint, plus application validation where useful
In a comment in the README
By allowing duplicates and cleaning them monthly
questions.answer_key: With a database UNIQUE constraint, plus application validation where useful
questions.explanation: The database constraint is the authoritative integrity boundary even when an application also validates input.

questions.prompt: Which predicate correctly finds rows with no optional date?
options: optional_date = NULL
optional_date IS NULL
optional_date == NULL
optional_date LIKE NULL
questions.explanation: SQL NULL must be tested with IS NULL or IS NOT NULL, not equality.

questions.prompt: An order insert succeeds but inventory update fails. Which design best avoids a partial order?
options: Run both writes independently and hope they both finish
Group the related InnoDB writes in a transaction and roll back on failure
Retry every statement without checking commit status
Remove foreign keys
questions.answer_key: Group the related InnoDB writes in a transaction and roll back on failure
questions.explanation: The transaction makes the related changes atomic when using a transaction-capable engine and correct boundaries.

questions.prompt: How should untrusted customer input be used in a query?
options: Concatenate it into SQL text
Use a prepared/parameterized statement and bind the input as a value
Give the user an administrator account
Escape only spaces
questions.answer_key: Use a prepared/parameterized statement and bind the input as a value
questions.explanation: Parameterization separates SQL structure from data values.

questions.prompt: What is the best first step when a query is slow?
options: Add several indexes immediately
Measure the query and inspect EXPLAIN/actual evidence before changing one thing
Remove all constraints
Increase every server setting
questions.answer_key: Measure the query and inspect EXPLAIN/actual evidence before changing one thing
questions.explanation: Optimization should follow evidence; indexes add write and storage cost.

questions.prompt: Which result demonstrates a backup plan is useful?
options: The backup command printed a message once
A restore test succeeds and data integrity and recovery objectives are checked
The backup filename exists
Backups are never deleted
questions.answer_key: A restore test succeeds and data integrity and recovery objectives are checked
questions.explanation: Restore verification is required to prove recoverability.

questions.prompt: What does replication lag mean operationally?
options: A replica may not yet have applied recent source changes
The source has no binary log
All replicas are always identical instantly
The connection pool is full
questions.answer_key: A replica may not yet have applied recent source changes
questions.explanation: Asynchronous replication can have delay; reads must account for consistency requirements.

questions.prompt: How should a version-sensitive feature be taught?
options: Assume every MySQL release behaves identically
Check the selected release manual and release notes, then label the supported scope
Copy an old blog and omit the version
Avoid all testing
questions.answer_key: Check the selected release manual and release notes, then label the supported scope
questions.explanation: Feature support and defaults can change between release lines.

questions.prompt: Which database test is most valuable beyond a happy-path query?
options: Only test that one row returns
Test constraints, NULL/duplicate boundaries, rollback and rebuild reproducibility
Avoid using synthetic fixtures
Run against production data
questions.answer_key: Test constraints, NULL/duplicate boundaries, rollback and rebuild reproducibility
questions.explanation: Database quality includes integrity and failure behavior.

questions.prompt: What access should a read-only reporting account receive?
options: Global ALL PRIVILEGES
Only the minimum required SELECT access on the required objects
A shared root password
No authentication
questions.answer_key: Only the minimum required SELECT access on the required objects
questions.explanation: Least privilege narrows the impact of mistakes or compromised credentials.
